description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifying various asynchronous methods for interacting with grain state and references.

methods.name: GetAge
methods.description: Retrieves the age of the grain as a TimeSpan.

methods.name: IncrCounter
methods.description: Increments an internal counter and returns its new value.

methods.name: SetOther
methods.description: Associates another ICollectionTestGrain instance with this grain.

methods.name: GetOtherAge
methods.description: Gets the age of the associated 'other' grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Provides a reference to this grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime instance ID as a string.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified period and delay.
